builtBy: research on 2026-10-03: four source-family sweeps (commitment lists, NorCal clubs and media, school and local news for each league) and a player-by-player sweep of every junior, senior and ungraded varsity row on the 37 teams with roster rows; every candidate then re-opened by a checker and, independently, by a refuter trying to break it; a completeness critic planned one more round of follow-ups (no new commitment; two more sources for existing ones); a final audit re-opened every source; written by hand from what survived
notes: Which players on the tracked varsity rosters (the 43 teams of the four leagues swept on 2026-10-03, and the six Eastern Athletic League teams swept on 2026-10-04) a public page says have committed to play field hockey in college, joined to data/rosters.json on team slug + MaxPreps athleteId. Only players on those rosters are named (varsity rows; rows the overlay marks JV, graduates, and players at schools with no MaxPreps rows are out of scope: six of the 43 on 2026-10-03, and Corning of the six EAL schools on 2026-10-04), each under the roster's own spelling.

The linking rule is the one data/clubs.json uses: a public page must name the player and the college in a field hockey context, and either name the player's high school, or give a class year that agrees with the roster grade together with a Northern California location (the player's hometown, or a club or team based in Northern California). A name alone never makes a match, and a class year that disagrees with the roster grade rules one out. College interests, offers, visits, camps and watchlists are not commitments, and neither is a commitment for another sport.

Social media is never a source (lib/clubs-schema.ts BANNED_HOSTS). Many commitments are announced only there, so a commitment with no other public page is not in this file. Every source names the player or is the player's own recruiting profile; quotes and bases are kept for maintainers and never rendered.

status: 'signed' only where a source says signed; otherwise 'committed'. No source found on 2026-10-03 said any player had signed. asOf: the earliest date a kept source gives for the commitment (a dated story's own date), or null. Every kept source was confirmed by a second, independent read: both verification passes for the sweeps' sources, and a hand re-read plus the final audit for the two the follow-ups added (St. Ignatius athletics' Oct 1, 2026 report and Stick Together's Feb 4, 2026 issue). A date from a page no second read could confirm (MAX Field Hockey's commitments table) is not used.

confidence: high = one first-hand page names the player, the college and the school, or it is the player's own recruiting profile showing the commitment; medium = the match rests on one line of a compiled list plus class year and a Northern California club.

The schools of the six Eastern Athletic League teams (Bella Vista, Chico, Corning, Davis, Lassen, Pleasant Valley) were swept on 2026-10-04 with the same sources (the NFHCA 2026 high school watchlist, the NCFHA youth directory, SportsRecruits profile slugs, fhcollegepath.com classes 2026-2028 and MAX Field Hockey) and no commitment was found; they add no row. The absence of a commitment is not proof that none exists.

Recall is partial: a commitment announced only on social media, on a page the sweeps could not read, or not yet published anywhere is not here. Re-running this is research, not a script; the class of 2027's signing period (November 2026) and the class of 2028's commitments are when it would change most.
